title: Validation result
description: One validator decision (av_sound.validate, ValidationResult.to_dict()). ok is true exactly when codes is empty. codes lists every failing reason code in the fixed order E_JSON, E_SCHEMA, E_DOMAIN, E_EVENT_SHORT, E_NONFINITE, E_CLIP, E_DUPLICATE, E_RESERVED, E_SEPARATION; messages[i] explains codes[i]. If the recipe did not parse or failed the schema, recipe, features, event_samples, pcm_sha256 and the nearest-reference fields are null.

threshold.description: Separation threshold used, as exact text: a decimal such as "0.1" or a fraction "p/q".

recipe_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical recipe JSON.

features.description: The 12 normalized features as exact fractions ("0", "1", "p/q"), in the order pitch 1-3, total, proportion 1-3, gap 1-2, amplitude 1-3.

event_samples.description: Samples per event after rounding (renderer spec D1).

pcm_sha256.description: Waveform hash; null if the recipe did not parse or the waveform is unusable (E_NONFINITE, E_CLIP).

nearest_id.description: ref_id of the nearest committed reference (ties: lowest index); null when none is committed.

nearest_distance.description: Distance to the nearest reference, for reporting (decisions use exact arithmetic).
